scope: Private noncommercial retrospective processed-data research; competition pending
selection: Reuse hash-pinned sensor_plus_baseline Ridge selections, no search
features: 21 existing sensor features followed by age,bmi,hba1c,fasting_glucose
paired_origins: Exact existing sensor_only origin IDs and outer folds; no exclusions silently removed
stage4: Existing 48h offset, 80% minute coverage and 100/100 origin gates
stage5: Existing 24h offset + 24h calibration, 60/30 support purges, 100 origin minima, rational ranks, 90%/95% intervals
comparison: Paired participant MAE/RMSE/signed error and above180 underprediction; macro and pooled interval coverage/width; participant bootstrap of paired MAE difference, seed 1705, 10000 resamples
baseline_assumption: Screening attributes assumed available before replay; actual result times unknown; HbA1c operational percent retains dictionary conflict
